themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's flight from Brazil after election defeat and judicial investigations, right-wing leaders across the Americas are actively coordinating support. Argentine and US MAGA networks provided logistical and political backing, triggering international debate over exile and foreign intervention.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Europe and Latin America are uniting around claims of state-sponsored lawfare and judicial overreach. Standoffs over Poland's Constitutional Tribunal have drawn vocal backing from Marine Le Pen in France, while Bolsonaristas in Brazil and AfD politicians in Germany challenge legal restrictions.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Populist right parties across Western Europe are escalating demands for strict border management, citizenship audits, and cultural integration. Figures in the UK, Spain, Sweden, and France are framing migration and asylum as existential threats to national identity.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties are recording major polling surges across Europe, positioning themselves as dominant forces ahead of upcoming national and regional contests. Fueled by anger over public service disruptions and economic stress, conservative blocs in Spain, Norway, Germany, and France are nearing potential governing majorities.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen continues to attract up to 19% of former Macron voters, cementing her status as 2027 presidential frontrunner.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Governing coalitions and far-right parties face growing internal splits regarding foreign policy commitments, electoral strategies, and ideological positioning. Public disputes over aid to Ukraine, legislative priorities, and cultural definitions are exposing fractures in Italy, Argentina, Sweden, and the US MAGA movement.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson and Richard Jomshof clashed publicly over party discipline and definitions of Swedish identity.
